description_expanded: ABOUT SLICE OF PARADISE: Slice of Paradise is a magnificent vacation home that offers an opulent and spacious living experience for up to 20 guests. This exquisite retreat boasts eight bedrooms and seven full bathrooms, with an additional half bath. The luxurious home offers breathtaking views throughout the home, making it a perfect vacation spot for those seeking a tranquil and rejuvenating escape. Upon entering Slice of Paradise, guests are welcomed into a lavish living space that features comfortable seating and a serene ambiance. The first floor also includes a laundry room, a kitchenette equipped with a microwave, sink, and mini-fridge, as well as two guest bedrooms. One of the guest bedrooms features two full over queen beds, while the other offers a queen bed and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower. Additionally, there is a full bathroom on this floor, ensuring the utmost convenience for all guests. Moving up to the second floor, guests are met with four more guest bedrooms, each offering its own unique charm and appeal. The first guest bedroom features a king bed and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, while the second guest bedroom offers a queen bed and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower as well. The third guest bedroom has a queen bed and shares a bathroom with the fourth guest bedroom, which features a queen bed and a full bed. The third-floor features two more guest bedrooms, each with their own private bathrooms and balconies overlooking the stunning Gulf of Mexico. The first guest bedroom offers a king bed and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, while the second guest bedroom offers a king bed, a private bathroom with a walk-in shower and tub, and two walk-in closets. There is also a laundry room on this floor for added convenience. The fourth floor of Slice of Paradise offers a chef's kitchen with top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, including a gas range, two dishwashers, and two sinks. The oversized marble center island with barstool seating for five is perfect for entertaining guests, while the stylish dining table with seating for eight provides an elegant dining experience. Additionally, the fourth floor features a half bathroom, a rooftop balcony with breathtaking views of the beach and gulf, and a private rooftop pool that can be heated for an additional fee. Outside, the home offers a private pool that can also be heated for an additional fee, an outdoor shower, parking for up to three vehicles, and four beach cruiser bicycles for guests to explore the area. Slice of Paradise is truly a luxurious retreat that offers everything guests need to experience a dream vacation. With its elegant decor, modern amenities, and stunning views, it's the perfect destination for families, friends, or couples seeking a slice of paradise. ABOUT THE AREA: Inlet Beach is a charming beach neighborhood located along Florida's scenic Highway 30A. Known for its stunning white sandy beaches, crystal-clear waters, and relaxed atmosphere, Inlet Beach offers a peaceful coastal getaway for visitors seeking a more laid-back vacation experience. This quaint community is characterized by its quiet residential streets lined with beautiful beach cottages and upscale vacation homes, perfect for those looking to unwind and enjoy the natural beauty of the Gulf Coast. When you stay in Inlet Beach you are never far from the beach, or a magnificent view. To explore 30A, take a bike ride to Rosemary Beach to enjoy the farmers market, discover the new 30A Avenue shops, taste the fine local cuisine, and visit local businesses along 30A. Visitors can also explore the neighboring beach communities of Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach, and Alys Beach, each offering unique shopping, dining, and entertainment options. For additional shopping and adventure, take a family drive to Pier Park in Panama City Beach or travel to the Sandestin Outlet shops. Inlet Beach provides easy access to a variety of outdoor activities, including swimming, sunbathing, paddleboarding, kayaking, and fishing. The nearby Camp Helen State Park offers nature trails for hiking and birdwatching, while Lake Powell - one of Florida's largest coastal dune lakes - provides opportunities for boating and wildlife viewing. With its pristine beaches, serene ambiance, and proximity to a wealth of recreational opportunities, Inlet Beach is a hidden gem along Highway 30A, perfect for those seeking a peaceful retreat on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Private Pool * Steps to the beach. * 4 bikes included. * Gulf Views PARKING: * Free Parking for 2 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must be 25 years or older * No Pets Allowed ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. **Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on at all times. At any given point, adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction without notification. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
